status.label: Design candidate
status.detail: Peek can be triggered by Space during Explorer rename after toggling Peek off/on, with another user confirming impact.

next_action.label: Design fix
next_action.reason: The scenario is reproducible enough for focused Peek hotkey/focus-state investigation.

actions.label: Design fix
actions.note: Dashboard-only action. No upstream comment or PR is posted by this artifact update.

judgment.rationale: The report gives a specific Peek toggle state and Explorer rename interaction, and a later commenter confirmed the issue is still affecting users.
evidence: Issue body: after toggling Peek off and back on, pressing Space while renaming in Explorer consistently triggers Peek.
The reporter notes it can also happen after restart if Peek has not been manually toggled on beforehand.
A later commenter reported the same issue and said they had to turn Peek off.
judgment.recommended_action: Run full Peek design investigation for toggle/hotkey registration and Explorer rename focus exclusion before proposing a fix.
